reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 1(a) retains Contractor only 'on a task by task basis' under individual Statements of Work, with no requirements commitment, minimum volume, sole-source designation, or restriction on Company procuring similar services elsewhere.

The only 'exclusive' references identified (Contractor's ownership of pre-existing materials; entire-agreement boilerplate) and the reciprocal employee non-solicitation in p0047 do not constrain Customer's sourcing freedom, consistent with the rule's detection guidance.

Redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment is present, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') confirms no residual exclusivity language.
No exclusivity benefiting Customer was removed, so the redline guidance is not implicated.
